name: getLanguageStrings
description: Shows every text the app uses for this feature, such as button and message wording, with any changes the owner made.

callback.description: Runs when it's done, with the texts.

error.description: Why it didn't work, if it didn't.

strings.description: Every app text, in the Language tab's order.

key.description: Which text this is, as listed in the app text choices.

section.description: The part of the app the text belongs to.

label.description: The text's name on the Language tab.

customText.description: The text the owner saved, if any.

defaultText.description: The text the app uses when none is saved.

text.description: The text the app shows now.

required.description: Whether the text can't be left empty.

maxLength.description: The most characters the text can have, if there is a limit.
